# Change

Describe what changed and why. Use the sections that help explain this change; remove unused prompts.

## Evidence or validation

Link the relevant argument, calculation, source, or checks actually performed. State the result's scope and any material unfinished work. Existing research notes or validation records can supply this information.

## Related sources

Link the original contribution, research result, or affected task when relevant. Canonical integration follows the applicable parts of [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/awdawmip/enterprise-math/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); ordinary notes and maintenance need no unrelated promotion or bilingual checklist.
